header.shortDesc: Advanced Oral Care, Now With Fluoride & Nano-Hydroxyapatite. Choose our 3-Product Bundle (Toothpaste, Mouthwash, Floss) or go all-in with the 4-Product Bundle (includes Gummies) for comprehensive enamel support powered by Hydroxamin™—our patented Liquid Enamel Technology featuring nano-hydroxyapatite, vitamin D3, vitamin K2, and now fluoride for extra cavity-fighting potential.
header.superHtml:
Looking for a fluoride-based option to further help protect against cavities? The SuperMouth Hydroxyapatite + Fluoride Bundle features Hydroxamin™, our proprietary formulation of nano-hydroxyapatite, vitamin D3, vitamin K2, xylitol, and prebiotics—enhanced by fluoride for next-level enamel strength. This synergy:

  • Reinforces Enamel: Nano-hydroxyapatite, sometimes called “liquid enamel,” fills microscopic surface imperfections to support smoother, more resilient teeth.
  • Helps Prevent Cavities: Fluoride is widely recognized for reducing the risk of tooth decay, making your enamel even more resistant to acid erosion.
  • Promotes Mineral Absorption: Vitamins D3 & K2 help optimize the use of these minerals, which is especially important if you’re deficient in either nutrient.
  • Maintains Oral Balance: Alkaline pH, xylitol, and prebiotics work together to nurture beneficial bacteria while discouraging harmful microbes.
    And it’s all available in one cohesive flavor—Mint, Strawberry, Vanilla, or Chocolate so you can enjoy a consistent taste across multiple products

Choose Your Bundle and Flavor

  • 3-Product Bundle: Perfect for those who want fluoride protection plus the added boost of nano-hydroxyapatite in their brushing, flossing, and rinsing.
  • 4-Product Bundle: Adds our exclusive Hydroxyapatite Gummies for daily, easy nutrient intake—further supporting effective mineral integration into your teeth.

cards.title: D3 aids in the absorption of calcium, whether it’s from your diet or the minerals provided in our products.
paras: K2 directs that calcium where it’s most needed—your teeth and bones—helping reduce the chance of it depositing elsewhere.
Many people are low in these vitamins, reducing their ability to fully benefit from fluoride or hydroxyapatite alone.

items.title: HOW TO USE
items.html:
• Brush with Hydroxyapatite + Fluoride Toothpaste at least twice daily.
  • Floss once a day to remove plaque between teeth and deliver active ingredients where bacteria often hide.
  • Rinse with Mouthwash (1 minute) first thing in the morning and the last thing in the evening before bedtime—no water rinse needed to let fluoride and nano-hydroxyapatite continue working.
  • Chew Gummies (in the 4-product bundle) daily to reinforce your system from the inside out, with vitamins D3 & K2 aiding nutrient absorption.
  • (Regular dental checkups remain important. Results vary by individual.)

reviews.name: Mellisa
reviews.title: Trio for me
reviews.body: I love the taste of this mint and the lack of chemical taste is reassuring that you’re getting the best ingredients for your mouth. The floss is amazing the density of this is easier on your gums but thick enough that floss where there may be a little space.

reviews.name: May
reviews.title: Working on getting used to new toothpaste
reviews.body: The texture of this toothpaste is very different from the regular commercial toothpaste I am used to.  Brushing does not generate any 'suds' so it felt like I did not properly clean my teeth.  This is also a very expensive product and I am not sure how many people can really afford this.  I am working on trying to get used this product as it is supposed to be good for dental health. Public Reply (Supermouth)

reviews.name: Anonymous
reviews.title: Very pleasantly surprised
reviews.body: I really struggle with mint flavored things so this was a very pleasant surprise. It honestly threw me for a loop bc it tastes nothing like toothpaste normally does. It is sweeter than I anticipated and I kind of wish they offered an unflavored version but so far so good.

reviews.name: Mellisa
reviews.title: Just a hint
reviews.body: The flavoring is very subtle. It taste good. It does a great job. I love the floss and the mouthwash. Make sure your mouth feel refreshed.

reviews.name: Anonymous
reviews.title: WE LOVE SuperMouth products except the strawberry rinse CHANGED
reviews.body: We are thrilled with all SuperMouth products until now and have left great reviews.  I am a hygienist and recommend all SuperMouth products to my patients.  However, this batch of strawberry mouthrinse with fluoride is a bit "off."  The color has changed and it tastes very sweet and not so much like strawberry like it has in the past.  I contacted the company the day we received it several weeks ago but have not heard back so I'm leaving this review.  Sorry, I do not like leaving negative reviews but I'm hoping I will find out why this batch is so different from the delicious strawberry rinse we've received consistently for the past year.  Thank you.
